scope: Bounded review of Qurtubi's post-fifteenth interpretation attributed to Ibn Ishaq, with the following Labid verse kept as a distinct quotation boundary. No external authenticity or isnad claim is made.

arabic.ibn_ishaq_clause: وقال ابن إسحاق : هو العظيم من الأمر

english.ending_excerpt: Whosoever desires to understand that should contemplate it there.
english.coverage_finding: Stored English ends during discussion of the first and second opinions, before this Ibn Ishaq/Labid segment.

source_anchors.locator: Surah 108:1, rendered lines 49-51; page header identifies page 602. Line 49 gives Ibn Ishaq's name and gloss 'هو العظيم من الأمر', then says a verse of Labid is cited; lines 50-51 provide the verse and gloss 'أي عظيم'.
source_anchors.finding: The authored text reports the 'great matter' interpretation with 'Ibn Ishaq said'. The Labid verse is textually distinguished as supporting poetry; its external provenance is not independently verified here.

source_anchors.locator: Al-Jami li-Ahkam al-Quran, displayed printed page 217, rendered lines 88-90; reports Ibn Ishaq, then introduces a Labid verse and glosses it as 'great'.
source_anchors.finding: The edition-bearing witness preserves the named-report and subsequent poem boundaries.
source_anchors.independence_note: A digitized witness to Qurtubi's authored text, not independent historical authentication of Ibn Ishaq's or Labid's words.

review_findings.literal_gloss: Ibn Ishaq said: it is the great matter; and he mentioned a verse of Labid.
review_findings.attribution_class: Qurtubi reports an interpretation in Ibn Ishaq's name
review_findings.speaker_for_gloss: Ibn Ishaq, as explicitly named by qāla in the text
review_findings.poem_boundary: The text separately calls the following verse a verse of Labid; whether wa-dhakara continues Ibn Ishaq as grammatical subject is not elevated into an independent-source claim.
review_findings.english_omission_scope: This later Arabic material is absent from the stored English segment; absence is a coverage boundary, not evidence of rejection.
